nodes.label: Historical baseline: 13 tests pass
nodes.rationale: Assets were hash-verified unchanged; the baseline alone did not detect independent acceptance defects.

nodes.label: Community compatibility list
nodes.rationale: Community-tested settings and workarounds are not an exhaustive supported-games list.

nodes.label: DLSSG via Streamline
nodes.rationale: Requires DX12 and Streamline 2+, using native swapchains for pacing.

nodes.label: Frame-generation input
nodes.rationale: Choose native frame-generation input where available.

nodes.label: Frame-generation output
nodes.rationale: Input and output must both be selected and require saved INI plus restart.

nodes.label: Native FSR 3.1 and FSR 3.0 FG
nodes.rationale: Requires enabling FSR-FG in game and Active in the overlay.

nodes.label: Nukem DLSSG-to-FSR3
nodes.rationale: Supports DX12 and Vulkan but locks output to FSR3-FG.

nodes.label: OptiFG Upscaler input
nodes.rationale: Fallback when native FG is absent or unusable; lack of HUDless resource can cause artifacts.

nodes.label: Streamline 1 games
nodes.rationale: Cannot be upgraded to Streamline 2; native DLSSG via SL is unsupported.

nodes.label: Unreal Engine motion vectors
nodes.rationale: Disable dilated DLSS motion vectors for OptiFG; native UE XeSS provides no depth and is not a valid upscaler input.

nodes.label: XeFG output requirements
nodes.rationale: Requires borderless display; excludes Vulkan, FP16 HDR/scRGB, RTSS Reflex injection, Anti-Lag 1 and Enhanced Sync.

nodes.label: Historical baseline test isolation
nodes.rationale: Temporary assets and profiles prevent fixture writes to real installed DLLs; forced offline fetch tests fallback only.

nodes.label: Historical ReviewAcceptance harness
nodes.rationale: Fake payloads and temporary game files test file orchestration, without loading DLLs or modifying a game process.

nodes.label: OptiFG HUDfix incompatibility
nodes.rationale: Wrong colors, tonemapping or textures can render HUDfix and FSR3-FG unusable; native DLSSG paths may be alternatives.

nodes.label: Eight proxy export and restore checks
nodes.norm_label: eight proxy export and restore checks
nodes.rationale: All eight report representative export presence, matching deployment hashes and exact original restoration.

nodes.label: Regression log: six import permission errors
nodes.norm_label: regression log: six import permission errors
nodes.rationale: This saved log reports dependency-access failures, despite the remediation report describing a later successful suite.

nodes.label: Remaining Intel Arc game acceptance
nodes.rationale: Host has UHD 730; per-game Arc driver, API, backend, rendering and recovery tests remain required.

nodes.label: Hardened release candidate validation
nodes.rationale: 51 regression passes and eight proxy round trips validate file operations, not in-game Arc rendering or performance.

nodes.label: Historical missing DX11 XeSS runtime
nodes.rationale: Deployment omitted libxess_dx11.dll despite choosing the native DX11 backend.

nodes.label: Historical failed-restore data loss
nodes.rationale: Restore errors were swallowed and recovery data discarded.

nodes.label: Historical pre-fix acceptance review
nodes.rationale: 22 of 23 independent acceptance tests failed despite 13 baseline passes; remediation document supersedes these historical defects.

nodes.label: Historical original-backup replacement defect
nodes.rationale: Reapply overwrote the only original backup.

nodes.label: Historical untracked configuration mutation
nodes.rationale: FakeNvapi INI lacked backup and unrelated imgui.ini was removed.

nodes.label: Historical incomplete package acceptance
nodes.rationale: Size-only validation accepted invalid binaries and omitted required runtime checks.

nodes.label: Historical process/target validation gaps
nodes.rationale: Same basenames, child paths, missing executables and unsupported hooks were mishandled.

nodes.label: Historical profile callback identity defect
nodes.rationale: Mutable current_profile let a launched-game callback update another selected game.

nodes.label: Historical configuration schema mismatch
nodes.rationale: Generated keys and filenames did not match the installed release template.

nodes.label: Historical snapshot ownership defect
nodes.rationale: Rollback without an owned manifest could delete untouched original files.

nodes.label: Historical watchdog false positives
nodes.rationale: Clean exits and substring PID matches could trigger destructive rollback.

nodes.label: Spider-Man 2 native frame-generation routes
nodes.rationale: FSR3.1 FG or DLSSG via SL can feed XeFG/FSR-FG; DLSSG must be enabled in-game to obtain HUDless resources.

nodes.label: Spider-Man 2 OptiScaler wiki entry
nodes.rationale: Documented test used OptiScaler 0.9, dxgi.dll, Windows 11 24H2 and RX 9070XT; it is not Arc runtime certification.

nodes.label: Spider-Man 2 GPU spoofing restriction
nodes.rationale: AMD/Intel ray tracing with GPU spoofing can crash at startup; Dxgi=false avoids unnecessary spoofing.

nodes.label: Intel Arc hardware detection
nodes.rationale: WMI identifies Arc and XMX; GPU spoofing is unnecessary by default.

nodes.label: Astra OptiScaler XeSS GUI
nodes.rationale: Automates per-game file deployment and recovery for Intel Arc owners; runtime interception belongs to the external libraries.

nodes.label: Native runtime detection
nodes.rationale: Exclude Astra-installed files from native capability detection; XeLL alone is insufficient evidence.

nodes.rationale: Structural checks and hash rebuilding support downloaded or manually extracted versions.

nodes.rationale: Allows explicit overrides of validation and unmanaged proxy conflicts after confirmation.
